text: On the other hand, a no project alternative would eliminate any adverse social and physical impacts that would be caused by implementation of the proposed plan and the other alternatives. Relocation trauma and the very minor negative impact on the neighborhood housing supply caused by the proposed demolition, the negative impacts on local ecology associated with the street improvements, the negative noise impacts associated with general construction activities, and all the other detrimental results of the proposed plan would be avoided by the adoption of the "no project alternative".
